name: trust-strip
description: Trust bar: a short label beside a row of customer or certification badges; on phones the row scrolls as a marquee. Live: the `.ap-trust` strip on every vertical, hub and solution page.

label.description: Label beside the badges, e.g. Trusted by fire departments nationwide.

accent.description: Part of the label to paint with the brand gradient. Must appear in label.

items.description: Badges. Each: image (required), alt; optional url; optional w and h (px) to draw the logo at its own size in the stacked layout.

layout.description: inline: the label beside the badges (vertical pages). hub: the Government, Healthcare, Construction and Manufacturing hubs (live #ap-gov-trust, ported whole: one row of 110x80 logos that never wraps; below 768px the label sits centred on one line above a marquee of 90x64 logos). eduhub: the Education hub (live #ap-eduhub-trust, ported whole: the label keeps its line break; at 900px and below the label centres above a marquee row; 88x64 logos at 600px and below). solution: the solution pages' strip (wider label, one row of 120x60 logos, marquee from 900px). stacked: the label centred above one row of logos at their own sizes, a marquee from 1140px down (Asset Intelligence Platform).

marquee.description: Scroll the badges on phones instead of wrapping them.
